name: shenxiaoli-platform
description: 深小狸 — A student-run campus community for SUAT (Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology). 评课 · 集市 · 技能互助 · 树洞.
comment: Thin delegating root. Each workspace owns its own dependencies — run bun install inside frontend/ or backend/, not here.

scripts.build: cd backend && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build && cd ../frontend && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.lint: cd backend && bun run lint && cd ../frontend && bun run lint
scripts.format:check: cd backend && bun run format:check && cd ../frontend && bun run format:check
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../frontend && bun run typecheck
scripts.setup: cd frontend && bun install && cd ../backend && bun install
